queries.compiledQueryString:
select
    symbol,
    name,
    price,
    market_cap,
    revenue,
    revenue_growth,
    earnings_growth,
    gross_margin,
    operating_margin,
    profit_margin,
    roe,
    roa,
    pe_forward,
    dividend_yield,
    sector,
    country
from market.stocks
where sector like '${inputs.earn_sector.value}'
  and (
    '${inputs.style_filter.value}' = 'all'
    or ('${inputs.style_filter.value}' = 'growth' and revenue_growth > 20)
    or ('${inputs.style_filter.value}' = 'value' and dividend_yield > 2)
  )
order by revenue_growth desc nulls last
